kind: Bounded original CCCL numerical/semantic qualification, not HYLE product or performance acceptance
machine: Windows RTX4070 SM89; MSVC19.50.35728, CUDA Toolkit13.3.73, CUB3.3.4 / 300304

scan.algorithm: Original InclusiveSumByKey on widened I32, original Min/Max, scalar validation and original Transform projection
scan.coverage: multiple rows, inclusive/exclusive, INT32_MIN/MAX, intermediate overflow and final total overflow, entire output sentinel unchanged on overflow

topk.algorithm: Original radix SortPairs custom decomposer of row/nan/directed-value, stable original index, original Transform extraction
topk.coverage: F32 and I32; both directions, k=1/7/8, two rows, NaN signs/payloads, infinities, signed zero, ties, integer keys beyond 2^24; selected source bits unchanged

limits: No ordinary HYLE entry or resource/Completion/Graph acceptance yet
No F16/BF16 qualification in raw probe
No WSL, SDK delivery, sanitizer or P1
No self-written math investigation, comparison, optimization or deletion
implementation_rule: Only stock DeviceScan/DeviceRadixSort/DeviceReduce/DeviceTransform algorithms; scalar API projection functors specify public ordering/address/type semantics, no own global kernel or scan/sort loop
